title: Chicken Milanese With Whipped Feta, Roasted Tomatoes & Lemon Basil Oil
blurb: The whipped feta doubles as the sauce here — bright with lemon, and enough of it that the roasted tomatoes don't need a vinaigrette on top.
steps: Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, oregano and garlic powder. Coat with breadcrumbs and place on a baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil.
Bake 18 to 22 minutes, until golden and crispy.
Toss the cherry tomatoes with olive oil and salt, then roast 15 to 20 minutes until blistered.
In a blender, blend the feta, yogurt, olive oil and lemon juice until smooth. Separately, blend the basil with olive oil and lemon zest to make the lemon basil oil.
Spread the whipped feta onto a plate, place the chicken on top, add the roasted tomatoes, and drizzle with the lemon basil oil. Garnish with fresh basil and serve warm.
